item: context/research/ROADMAP_v2.md item 6 (grouped conformal intervals + applicability-domain flag in the engine API) and item 7(c) (Monte-Carlo the per-target intervals into a CFRS interval)
declared: Drafted 2026-10-22 by the Uncertainty Engineer (Claude) on branch engine-uncertainty, cut from relaunch-v2 at aaf695f. Written before any interval, residual, coverage or width had been computed for the engine model; the git commit time is the timestamp. Committed before api/build_uncertainty.py runs.
report_only: No R2, CI, leaderboard row or number of record changes. Nothing is written to experiments/results/. Output: experiments/runs/conformal_round1.json (+ .log) and the serving artifact api/uncertainty.joblib.
prior_looks: None for this model. data/v2/conformal*.py covered the FSRI/LOI records (different populations and models). For the engine, only shapes were inspected while drafting: rows per target (TTI 3,368 / pHRR 4,017 / THR 3,355 / avg_HRR 759, from context/facts/engine.md), 806 papers, and the label-free count of components per row (p99 = 10, max = 12) and heat-flux range (10-95 kW/m2).

data.sealed_set_rule: context/decisions/SEALED_TEST_SET.md: wave 2 is never used to train, tune or calibrate. The snapshot is the 2026-10-17 engine training set and predates the wave-2 commit (0fcca80, Oct 20); the script asserts the sha above and the compact artifact's data_sha256 before doing anything, so no wave-2 row can enter.
data.rows_per_target: engine rule: target > 0 and heat_flux_kWm2 present (engine/dravix_engine.py train)
data.groups: paper = the snapshot's `group` column (DOI-level paper id used by every P3 run)

model.what: The engine's own model, unchanged: T.primary() (HGB + ExtraTrees + Ridge average) on log1p(y), engine features (v3 + the frozen top-100 additive vocabulary from the compact bundle), re-fit per fold. Point predictions served by the API stay exactly what engine/dravix_engine.py predict returns.
model.feature_builder: api/uncertainty.features() re-implements the engine's predict-time feature block (engine/ is Arnav's and is not edited). The build script asserts it equals T.build_X(TOPN=100) on the training snapshot, and api/test_uncertainty.py asserts the mean of the compact model's members on it equals the engine's served prediction.

method.score_scale: log1p; residual r = log1p(y) - mu, mu = mean of the three member predictions

candidates.A_abs: s = |r| (split/cross conformal, constant width on the log scale)
candidates.B_spread: s = |r| / (sd_members + median(sd_members over calibration rows)); sd_members = std of the 3 member predictions on the log scale
candidates.C_knn: s = |r| / (d_nn + median(d_nn over calibration rows)); d_nn = Euclidean distance to the nearest training row of the fitting set (other papers only) in the standardized feature space below

method.feature_space_for_distance: engine feature matrix; NaN -> training column median; each column divided by its training std (std 0 -> column dropped). Label-free, fit on the whole snapshot.
method.quantile: group-weighted conformal quantile, data/v2/conformal.py weighted_upper with weights = 1 / rows of the paper (each paper carries weight 1), alpha = 0.20 and 0.10
method.interval: log scale [mu - q*sigma, mu + q*sigma], back-transformed with expm1 and clipped to the engine's training range [ymin, ymax] for that target (clipping cannot change coverage of a training row)

validation.outer: repeats r = 0..4: GroupKFold(5, shuffle=True, random_state=r) by paper. Each fold refits the engine model on 4/5 of papers; held-out rows get OOF mu, sd_members and d_nn (nearest neighbour among the fitting rows of that target).
validation.conformal_step: within each repeat, GroupKFold(5, shuffle=True, random_state=1000+r) by paper over the OOF rows: the quantile is computed from 4/5 of papers' OOF scores and applied to the other 1/5. Every interval is scored on papers that neither fitted the model nor calibrated the quantile.
metrics_per_target_level_candidate: row coverage (mean over the 5 repeats; min and max across repeats)
paper-mean coverage (mean over papers of each paper's row coverage)
mean and median width in raw units (clipped), mean full width on the log1p scale
coverage and median width split by the OOD flag (flagged vs not), 90% level
validation.cfrs_check: rows with all four targets measured: measured CFRS (engine/score/cfrps.py, v1 weights) vs the Monte-Carlo CFRS 80/90% interval built from OOF mu, the selected candidate's sigma and per-target q (calibrated on the other 4/5 papers). Report-only coverage and mean width.

selection_rule: Per target, a candidate is eligible if its mean row coverage is >= nominal - 0.02 at both levels AND its paper-mean coverage is >= nominal - 0.05 at both levels. Among eligible candidates pick the smallest mean log-scale width at 90%. If none is eligible, ship A_abs and say so. The rule is applied once, mechanically, by the script.

ood_flag (fixed here, not tuned).unseen_matrix: matrix_canonical not among the engine's mat_cats (matrices with >= 3 papers). In validation: fewer than 3 papers with that matrix in the fitting folds.
ood_flag (fixed here, not tuned).unseen_form: material_form not in the engine's form_cats
ood_flag (fixed here, not tuned).additive_count: number of non-matrix components > 99th percentile of the training snapshot (label-free; stored in the artifact)
ood_flag (fixed here, not tuned).heat_flux: heat flux missing or outside 10-95 kW/m2 (the training range)
ood_flag (fixed here, not tuned).distance: d_nn to the target's training rows > 95th percentile of the OOF d_nn distribution (repeat 0) for that target
ood_flag (fixed here, not tuned).use: flag + reasons per target in the API response; the interval is not widened by the flag (C_knn widens by distance if selected). Coverage on flagged rows is reported so the flag's meaning is measured, not assumed.

cfrs_interval.how: Monte Carlo, 4,000 draws, fixed seed (common random numbers, so for a fixed sigma every draw is monotone in each property and the percentiles are monotone too). Per draw: log1p value_t = mu_t + z_t * sigma_t * q90_t / 1.645 with z ~ N(0, Corr); Corr = Pearson correlation of the signed normalized OOF residuals r/sigma between targets (pairwise-complete rows, repeat 0, eigenvalues floored at 1e-6). Back-transform, clip to [ymin, ymax], score with the served CFRS weights (renormalized over the four engine outputs, exactly as cfrps() does). Interval = 10-90 / 5-95 / 2.5-97.5 percentiles, widened if needed to contain the point score.
cfrs_interval.monotonicity_test: api/test_uncertainty.py: shifting one property's mu toward higher risk with sigma fixed never lowers the CFRS point or either bound.

ram_budget: API process peak RSS must stay < 512 MB (Render free). Measured after the change with the same method as ENGINE_QA (model load + predict).
